title: Just Biome message
description: A simple plugin that displays the name of the biome on the player's screen or in the hotbar
body:
### JBM
Just Biome Message - is a small plugin that slightly complements the game, it outputs an message about logging into the biome

![Forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/448c67ee09f2b33d092c75123edb7704646fa7c3.png)

### Config
You can configure the name of each biome in the config.yml
> **/jbm reload** - use configuration reloads

You can also choose in the configuration where the message will be displayed in the title or in the actionbar

### Permissions
> **justbiomemessage.reload** - justbiomemessage.reload - gives the right to reloaded the config

**Version: 1.13-1.20.X**
**Java: 8 or higher**
